description: Run detection learning for the account now (it also runs every hour): label the base rules' recent alerts (was the rule right?), measure each rule's precision per app, and learn a safe exclusion for a rule below 95% that keeps mistaking an app's legitimate traffic for an attack. A learned exclusion never names an IP and must keep every correct alert and every known attack firing. An account where detection learning isn't on yet gets 409 not_rolled_out. Write action; requires confirmation.

app.description: Optional application key; every app when left out.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.
